## Summary

Describe the user problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] Added or updated tests for the changed behavior
- [ ] `yarn typecheck`
- [ ] `yarn lint`
- [ ] `yarn test`
- [ ] `yarn i18n:check` (required for user-visible text)
- [ ] `yarn build` / desktop smoke test when relevant

## Risk and scope

Describe affected layers, migration or compatibility concerns, and anything intentionally left out.

## Privacy and assets

- [ ] Logs and screenshots contain no credentials, user code, conversation content, database data, or identifying local paths
- [ ] New dependencies and copied assets have compatible licenses and required notices

## Screenshots

Include sanitized before/after screenshots for visible UI changes.
